passage:
M: That recipe card has two times on it. Grandma wrote twenty minutes in ink, and Dad wrote fifteen in pencil below it. Which one goes into our booklet?
F: Both, but don’t put them on the same line. Twenty is for a full pan. Dad halved the recipe when he used the smaller pan.
M: I was planning to photograph the card first. I can see the pencil note if I lift the fold, but the clear sleeve presses it closed.
F: Take a second photo of the note by itself. Keep that picture with the first, but write the two versions separately in the booklet.
passageZh:
M：那張食譜卡上有兩個時間。奶奶用墨水寫二十分鐘，爸爸在下面用鉛筆寫十五分鐘。哪個要放進我們的小冊子？
F：兩個都放，但別寫在同一行。二十分鐘是整盤。爸爸用較小的烤盤時，把食譜份量減半。
M：我本來想先拍食譜卡。把折起來的部分掀開才看得到鉛筆註記，但透明套會把折的地方壓住。
F：另外單獨拍一張註記。把那張跟第一張照片放一起，但在冊子裡要分開寫兩種版本。
